001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.abilities.ai;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken.VisibilityLevel;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.ai.FleetAIFlags;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.events.BaseEventPlugin.MarketFilter;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class SensorBurstAbilityAI extends BaseAbilityAI {
014
015        private IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.05f, 0.15f);
016
017//      public SensorBurstAbilityAI(AbilityPlugin ability, ModularFleetAIAPI ai) {
018//              super(ability, ai);
019//      }
020
021        public void advance(float days) {
022                interval.advance(days);
023                if (!interval.intervalElapsed()) return;
024                
025//              if (fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
026//                      ability.activate();
027//                      return;
028//              }
029                
030                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
031                //if (mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS)) return;
032                
033                if (ability.isActiveOrInProgress()) {
034                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_SPEED_PENALTY, true, 0.2f);
035                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_VISION_BONUS, true, 0.2f);
036                        mem.set(FleetAIFlags.HAS_HIGHER_DETECTABILITY, true, 0.2f);
037                        return;
038                }
039                
040                if (fleet.getOrbit() != null) {
041                        return;
042                }
043                
044                CampaignFleetAPI pursueTarget = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.PURSUIT_TARGET);
045                CampaignFleetAPI fleeingFrom = mem.getFleet(FleetAIFlags.NEAREST_FLEEING_FROM);
046                
047                // being pursued: definitely not
048                if (fleeingFrom != null) {
049                        return;
050                }
051                
052                // pursuing an enemy, but can't see them anymore
053                if (pursueTarget != null) {
054                        VisibilityLevel level = pursueTarget.getVisibilityLevelTo(fleet);
055                        if (level != VisibilityLevel.NONE) return; // can already see them
056                        
057                        
058                        float daysUnseen = mem.getFloat(FleetAIFlags.DAYS_TARGET_UNSEEN);
059                        float prob = (daysUnseen - 1f) * 0.1f;
060                        //prob /= EmergencyBurnAbilityAI.AI_FREQUENCY_MULT;
061                        
062                        MarketAPI nearestMarket = Misc.findNearestLocalMarket(fleet, 1000000, new MarketFilter() {
063                                public boolean acceptMarket(MarketAPI market) {
064                                        return true;
065                                }
066                        });
067                        if (nearestMarket != null && nearestMarket.getFaction().isHostileTo(fleet.getFaction())) {
068                                prob *= 0.25f;
069                        }
070                        
071                        if (Math.random() < prob) {
072                                ability.activate();
073                        }
074                        
075                        return;
076                }
077                
078                boolean trader = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_TRADE_FLEET);
079                boolean smuggler = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SMUGGLER);
080                if (trader || smuggler) {
081                        return;
082                }
083                
084                // not pursuing or being pursued, use now and again; more often if nearest market is friendly
085                MarketAPI nearestMarket = Misc.findNearestLocalMarket(fleet, 1000000, new MarketFilter() {
086                        public boolean acceptMarket(MarketAPI market) {
087                                return true;
088                        }
089                });
090                float prob = 0.01f;
091                if (nearestMarket != null && nearestMarket.getFaction().isHostileTo(fleet.getFaction())) {
092                        prob *= 0.25f;
093                }
094                if (Math.random() < prob) {
095                        ability.activate();
096                }
097        }
098}
